purpose: Risk-based execution approval for lawful PC work. Read-only work proceeds; anything privileged, destructive, signing, financial, credential-touching or publishing needs an explicit human role before execution.
escalation_rule: When any action in a batch requires a higher level, the whole batch inherits the highest level. Missing approval never defaults to allowed.

controls: no writes outside the output path

reversible.description: Modification with a verified backup or snapshot that can be restored exactly.
controls: rollback command captured in the report

networked.description: Any outbound network access, download, or remote service call.

privileged.description: Administrator, root, kernel, driver, service, firmware or registry writes.

destructive.description: Deletion, overwrite, format, partition, wipe or any loss of original data.
controls: verified backup of every affected artifact

signing.description: Code signing, notarization, timestamping or attestation with a key you own.

financial.description: Any purchase, subscription, licence payment or billing change.
controls: price and term recorded before purchase

credential.description: Creating, rotating, reading or transmitting credentials, tokens or keys.

publishing.description: Publishing, releasing, uploading or distributing artifacts outside the workspace.

blocked_classes.license-bypass: Bypassing licensing, activation or DRM is prohibited regardless of approval.
blocked_classes.access-control-bypass: Bypassing authentication, authorization or account controls is prohibited.
blocked_classes.anti-cheat-bypass: Circumventing anti-cheat or anti-tamper protections is prohibited.
blocked_classes.credential-theft: Extracting credentials or tokens from systems you do not own is prohibited.

approval_record.storage: Attach the approval record to the run evidence folder before execution; this tool never grants approval itself.
